problem: Jira admins need continuous policy-focused monitoring and longer-lived evidence for security-relevant configuration changes without manually reviewing the audit log.
proposedWorkflow: Poll Jira audit records on a five-minute schedule, evaluate high-risk admin and configuration events against policy packs, retain governed evidence inside Forge storage, and surface an admin risk queue.
governance: This product brief is research output. Only a scorecard marked READY_FOR_BUILD may enter the isolated Atlassian build pipeline.
